facts.text: PS2 (design review), 'PRODUCER STATEMENT - PS2 - DESIGN REVIEW': review firm to the owner, to be supplied to Tauranga City Council, 'in respect of' seismic strengthening at 46 Spring Street. The page carries council approval-stamp text (garbled in extraction).
PS2 says the review concerns Building Regulations 1992 clause B1 (verification method B1/VM1, text partly garbled) for a design prepared by Arnold & Johnstone Ltd.
Calculations cover sheet: 'SEISMIC STRENGTHENING, 46 SPRING STREET', job no. 11413, dated 30 July 2014.

PS1 (design), issued by Arnold & Johnstone Ltd and addressed to the building consent authority, covers structural design under Clause B1 (Structure) for items marked and countersigned on the drawings.
PS1 says the design follows compliance documents B1/VM1 and Acceptable Solution B1/AS1 issued by the Department of Building & Housing.

PS1 conditions: (i) site verification that the ultimate bearing capacity of the ground beneath the building is at least 300 kPa; (ii) all proprietary products meet their performance specification requirements.
Second PS2 design-review copy in the Part 2 file: 'Seismic Strengthening to 71% NBS', at 46 Spring Street, with Tauranga City Council approval-stamp text.
